questions.q: The Indian National Congress was founded in which year?
questions.exp: The Indian National Congress (INC) was founded on 28 December 1885 by Allan Octavian Hume, along with Dadabhai Naoroji and Dinshaw Wacha.

questions.q: Who gave the slogan 'Do or Die' during the Quit India Movement?
questions.exp: Mahatma Gandhi gave the slogan 'Do or Die' (Karo ya Maro) during the Quit India Movement on 8 August 1942 at Gowalia Tank Maidan, Bombay.

questions.q: The Partition of Bengal was done in which year?
questions.exp: The Partition of Bengal was carried out in 1905 by Lord Curzon. It divided Bengal into East Bengal (Muslim majority) and West Bengal (Hindu majority), leading to widespread protests.

questions.q: Who is known as the 'Iron Man of India'?
questions.exp: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel is known as the Iron Man of India. He unified 562 princely states into the Indian Union after independence.

questions.q: The Jallianwala Bagh massacre occurred in which year?
questions.exp: The Jallianwala Bagh massacre occurred on 13 April 1919 in Amritsar. General Dyer ordered firing on a peaceful gathering, killing hundreds of unarmed civilians.

questions.q: The Dandi March was undertaken to protest against?
questions.exp: The Dandi March (Salt March) was undertaken by Mahatma Gandhi from 12 March to 6 April 1930 to protest against the British Salt Tax. It covered 388 km from Sabarmati Ashram to Dandi.
Subhas Chandra Bose founded the All India Forward Bloc on 22 June 1939. He believed in armed struggle against British rule.

questions.q: India got independence on which date?
questions.exp: India got independence on 15 August 1947. Jawaharlal Nehru became the first Prime Minister and Lord Mountbatten was the last Viceroy of British India.

questions.q: The Constitution of India came into force on?
questions.exp: The Constitution of India came into force on 26 January 1950, which is celebrated as Republic Day. It was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on 26 November 1949.

questions.q: Who was the first President of independent India?
questions.exp: Dr. Rajendra Prasad was the first President of India (1950–1962). He was also the President of the Constituent Assembly that drafted the Indian Constitution.
